changes.text: Games, gacha, predictions and player trades spend Credit first and dip into your cash only once it runs out. Refunds go back where the money came from.
Credit now counts toward your net worth and the leaderboard. All-time change starts from what everyone begins with, cash and Credit together.
Saturday's conversion turns 5% of your Credit into cash, or $10,000 if that's more.
Profiles show cash and Credit side by side.
